terra.problem: It says Amaziah sent word to the king instead of talking to Amos, but Amaziah does speak to Amos in the passage.
Amaziah sent word to the king; the text does not say he ran to him.
Judah's location south of Bethel is not given in the passage, and the explanation supplies no reference for it.
Amaziah names a destination, but the text does not say he planned a route.
The text does not say Amaziah is guarding Bethel.
The sentence mentions the king, but it does not give his name.
Calling Uzziah king of Judah is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Calling Hezekiah a king of Judah is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The text says the land will be divided, but does not say it will no longer belong to Amaziah.
Saying Amaziah sent Amos packing implies Amos left, but the passage only says Amaziah told him to leave.
